newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds mixed on quiet market.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds mixed on quiet market.

text.p: High protein soymeal prices were mixed on a quiet UK meals and feeds market on Friday.
Offers for high pro ranged from one stg up to one stg lower while Brazilian 48's were unchanged to one stg down.
The remainder of the market was mostly unchanged with only old crop A.D.M. rapemeal bucking the trend at 0.50 stg down.

"There is little demand from compounds because farmers are taking advantage of the weather and keeping cattle out in the fields. But if the dry weather continues it could become bullish for the market," said one broker.
